WEAVER-FUSE.title: Fuse
WEAVER-FUSE.description: When played, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this. A card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] gains its effects, including your current [gold]Alignment[/gold] bonuses, and its cost for the rest of combat. Matching effects combine into one. That card gains [gold]Fuse[/gold].
